facts.text: I am trying to keep track of my expenses for the past few months.
I want help categorizing my spending on gifts.
I bought a birthday gift for my sister-in-law.
I bought a silver necklace from a boutique on Main Street.
I paid around $50 for the silver necklace.
I paid $5 for wrapping for the silver necklace.
I bought gifts for my nephew's birthday.
I bought a $20 gift card to my nephew's favorite gaming store.
I went to the mall with my friends.
I shopped at the mall for my best friend's baby shower.
I spent around $70 in total on gifts.
I bought cute onesies as gifts.
I bought a set of baby books as gifts.
I bought a soft toy as a gift.
I bought gifts for my colleagues for our office's Secret Santa gift exchange.

events.text: Bought a birthday gift for my sister-in-law
Bought a silver necklace from a boutique on Main Street and paid about $50 plus $5 for wrapping
Bought gifts for my nephew's birthday, including a $20 gift card to his favorite gaming store
Went to the mall with my friends to shop for my best friend's baby shower
